title: Testing the per-request OpenFeature evaluation context in contexthandler
answers: how to test which namespace OpenFeature sees for a request
unit test the openfeature transaction context set by the context handler
fake an authn identity with a namespace in contexthandler tests
body:
Pattern used in pkg/services/contexthandler/contexthandler_test.go:TestContextHandler:
- Build the handler with contexthandler.ProvideService(cfg, &authntest.FakeService{ExpectedIdentity: &authn.Identity{ID, Type: claims.TypeUser, Namespace}}, featuremgmt.WithFeatures()). Set cfg.StackID on setting.NewCfg() to test the stack fallback.
- Create webtest.NewServer(t, routing.NewRouteRegister()), call server.Mux.Use(handler.Middleware) and register a route with server.Mux.Get.
- Inside the route, read openfeature.TransactionContext(c.Req.Context()) and assert on evalCtx.TargetingKey() and evalCtx.Attribute("namespace").
- Send the request with server.Send(server.NewGetRequest(path)) and close res.Body.
applies: Unit tests for request-context and OpenFeature setup in pkg/services/contexthandler
